projects.subtitle: Data Warehousing & BI

projects.name: Databricks Medallion Sales Pipeline
projects.subtitle: Cloud Big Data

projects.name: SA Job Market Pipeline & Tracker
projects.subtitle: Advanced ETL & Analytics
projects.summary: A robust daily automated pipeline that aggregates tech jobs from APIs and web scrapers. Implemented a 'Zombie Job' filter to remove expired listings, deduplication logic, and SCD Type 1 storage in PostgreSQL.
projects.outcome: Automated the entire data lifecycle from ingestion to visualization, creating a clean historical dataset of the SA tech market tracking 967+ active jobs.

projects.name: AI Lyric Video Generator
projects.subtitle: AI Pipeline & Containerization
projects.summary: A cloud-native media processing app. Integrates the Faster-Whisper AI model for precise audio transcription and MoviePy for dynamic text overlays. Containerized with Docker to run efficiently on low-memory cloud tiers.
projects.outcome: Successfully deployed a resource-heavy AI/Video pipeline on free-tier infrastructure using advanced optimization and Docker.

projects.outcome: Automated the data collection process, reducing manual research time to zero.
